verdict.rationale: AgentMail documents an official hosted MCP server at https://mcp.agentmail.to/mcp that exposes inbox, message, thread, draft, and attachment tools to any compatible MCP client, and a probe confirms the official MCP docs page exists. This covers the core of connecting an agent through an official MCP server. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the server works in practice, and documented details on authentication and client setup.
